name: Magnetic Mount for Jumper Wire Rack

captions.detailed: A long, flat, rectangular bar with rounded circular ends, resembling a mounting bracket or handle base. The main flat body features two small screw holes positioned near each rounded end. On the underside, the rounded ends extend downwards as cylindrical feet or caps, while two circular magnet inlay cavities are recessed along the bottom face.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric baseplate mount with rounded endcaps, screw holes, and circular magnet inlays on the underside. The user should be able to adjust the base height, width, thickness, screw diameter, and the number, depth, and diameter of the magnet inlays.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a difference() boolean operation on a union of baseplate components. The baseplate union consists of a central cube and two cylinders translated to the ends to form the rounded endcaps. From this solid, two small cylinders are subtracted to create screw holes at the ends, and a loop is used to subtract cylindrical magnet inlays (complete with smaller concentric push-through holes for magnet removal) on the underside.
